heading: Agreements to effectuate leases
lead: The Secretary of the Interior may enter into agreements with other Federal agencies and with any concessioner or its successor in order to effectuate the purposes of sections 47–2 to 47–6 of this title.

notes.heading: Codification
notes.text: Section was classified to section 47–2(b) of this title prior to renumbering by Pub. L. 99–542.
